title: LeakageBench-MIDI: Measuring and Mitigating Same-Work Family Leakage in Symbolic Music Generation
description: A public-safe release for measuring and mitigating same-work family leakage in symbolic music generation evaluation. It includes reusable code, anonymous analysis units, a provenance-labelled field audit, final tables and figures, and automated integrity checks. Of 232 numerical fields, 193 are recomputed from public rows and 39 are verified from frozen summaries. No original LMD or PDMX music data, token sequences, or model checkpoints are redistributed.
